text:
maya: Quick alert — SCIM pruner run left dangling parent refs for ~40 groups. Some users still have access after deprovision.
ops-bot: [alert] scim-pruner completed with warnings job=pruner-2026-03-19-23:12
arjun: paste the pruner logs?
maya: 
```
2026-03-19T23:11:59Z pruner INFO scanned=512 groups_removed=470 groups_warn=42
2026-03-19T23:12:00Z pruner WARN stale_parent_refs=["org/eng/platform","org/eng/special"]
2026-03-19T23:12:00Z pruner ERROR cleanup_failed group_id=G-8421 cause="link-not-found-on-sync-service"
```
maya: Looks like child groups were removed but parent ref entries remained in rbac_role_map. KMS checks rely on that table.
samira: So KMS key ACLs could be granting roles via these stale refs?
maya: Yup. Spot-checked key kms-key-77 — it still had grant role:data-analyst via stale parent.
arjun: Mitigation: revoke stale refs and re-run pruner. Any safe one-off script?
kevin: I'll run revoke_orphaned_links.py in dry-run.
kevin: dry-run output:
```
./scripts/revoke_orphaned_links.py --dry-run --limit=100
would_revoke=42 links
sample: user:U-123 -> role:org/eng/platform (stale)
```
kevin: Ran actual revoke. removed=42. no service impact observed. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: [audit] manual_revoke by kevin job=manual-revoker-564 ts=1887654401
sre-oncall: Please add runbook + short postmortem note. We need to close the loop.
maya: Root cause theory: pruner does multi-phase child->parent cleanup. If a concurrent SCIM event (rename/add) happens between phases the parent link can be recreated or left dangling. Also delete path lacks a compare-token so it's not idempotent.
arjun: Fix plan:
- add compare-and-delete token to pruner (transactional)
- add post-prune integrity verifier (console runnable)
- add unit & integ tests simulating concurrent SCIM edits
kevin: PR: github.com/redwood/pruner/pull/214 — includes compare-token + audit detail. tagging @arjun @maya for review.
arjun: I'll review. Add a migration to reconcile current stale refs.
maya: I ran reconcile once; results: 42 revoked, 0 false positives. Linked ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-726
samira: I'll add tests in scim-sync-test-suite and a chaos test. Also add alert if orphaned_links > 5 for >15m.
maya: Compliance wants deleted link ids in audit. Can we append deleted_link_ids to pruner audit events and to KMS-change log?
arjun: Yes. We'll include deleted_link_ids and affected_key_ids in the audit event.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: pruner-service v2.1.3 -> canary(10%) 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z
kevin: I'll prepare migration and postmortem draft. assigning to me + maya.
sre-oncall: Action items: 1) merge PR + canary 2) run stage replay 3) add alert & runbook. Creating incident stub now.
maya: Closing for now. Reopen if alert fires. Thanks everyone :heart:
